title: RimWorld NeedDef -> Glue Need-Key Adapter
description: Maps RimWorld's real NeedDef.defName values (verified against the installed 1.6.4871 Data/Core/Defs/NeedDefs/Needs.xml on this machine) to the need-taxonomy keys already relocated into the glue monorepo at schemas/seeds/actors/needs/pawn-need-taxonomy.json (colony/pawn-need-taxonomy, landed by the Zomboid Z-1 lane, commit f40f3d710) and to the 'values'/'rates' map shape actor/runtime/zomboid-day-tick expects (hunger/energy/... deficits derived by actor/status/derive-deficits). This file is genuinely RimWorld-specific glue code (an adapter table), not reusable engine content -- it lives in GlueRimworld's own Seeds/ rather than in the glue monorepo's schemas/seeds/actors/.

needMappings.notes: Direct 1:1. Need.CurLevel (0..1, higher = more satisfied) maps straight onto glue's 'values.hunger'.

Direct 1:1. Joy is colonistsOnly + adult-only in RimWorld (see Needs.xml); pawns without this need are mapped to a satisfied placeholder (1.0, no deficit pressure) rather than omitted, so derive-deficits never sees a missing key.

unmappedGlueNeeds.notes: colony/pawn-need-taxonomy.json carries a 'social' need (real for Zomboid/Project Zomboid's social system) that has NO corresponding vanilla RimWorld NeedDef -- confirmed against the real installed Needs.xml (Mood/Food/Rest/Joy/Beauty/Comfort/Outdoors/Indoors/DrugDesire/RoomSize, no Social entry). RimWorld instead expresses social pressure through mood Thoughts (e.g. time-alone thought stages), not a formal Need. GlueRimworldMod currently feeds a constant placeholder (0.5) for 'social' rather than inventing a fake decaying need; a real mapping would read pawn.needs.mood.thoughts.memories for isolation-shaped thoughts -- left for a follow-on pass, disclosed rather than faked as a real signal.
